links.comparator_used: Undefended baseline VLM inference on images with embedded prompt injection (no defense); five defenses benchmarked including image cropping, OCR-based text sanitization, and ProvDent
links.outcome: Attack success rate of image-embedded prompt injection across four VLMs on dental panoramic radiographs
links.effect: OCR-based sanitization pooled ASR 0.2%, versus baseline paired attack success rates up to 62.6% (95% CI: 58.5–66.7%) for GPT-4o
links.tradeoff: All defenses preserved clean-image F1 within 0.6 percentage points of baseline on a high-prevalence benchmark; ProvDent is a fail-open mechanism that escalates suspicious cases for human review.
links.quote: OCR-based sanitization achieved the strongest attack reduction (pooled ASR: 0.2%), while ProvDent provided a complementary fail-open governance mechanism that escalates suspicious cases for human review.

design_hint: input sanitization and prompt injection defense guardrails
